title: Stock SIP Calculator
formula_verified: Stock SIP: Same as mutual fund SIP formula. FV = P × [(1+r)^n − 1] / r × (1+r). r = monthly return of stock = (annual CAGR)/12/100. Unlike MF, stock SIP has higher risk; no expense ratio but brokerage applies each purchase.

what_is: A Stock SIP Calculator is a digital tool that allows you to periodic investment in stocks without complex manual calculations. In the Indian financial ecosystem, accurate calculations are crucial given dynamic tax slabs, RBI interest rate changes, SEBI regulations, and government scheme updates. This calculator incorporates all India-specific parameters to give you precise, actionable results.
how_to_use: Step 1: Open the Stock SIP Calculator on this page. Step 2: Enter your Monthly Investment in Stock (₹) (e.g., ₹5,000). Step 3: Enter your Expected Stock CAGR (%) (e.g., ₹15). Step 4: Enter your Investment Period (Years) (e.g., ₹10). Step 5: Click 'Calculate' to see instant results. Step 6: Review the detailed breakdown and use results for financial planning. Step 7: Adjust inputs to explore different scenarios.
formula_explanation: The Stock SIP Calculator uses: Stock SIP: Same as mutual fund SIP formula. FV = P × [(1+r)^n − 1] / r × (1+r). r = monthly return of stock = (annual CAGR)/12/100. Unlike MF, stock SIP has higher risk; no expense ratio but brokerage. Each variable is derived from your inputs with Indian regulatory parameters.
example_calculation: Example: Using default values – Monthly Investment in Stock (₹)=5000, Expected Stock CAGR (%)=15, Investment Period (Years)=10 → computed results shown in the output section below.
